youtube_description:
We had a pleasant conversation with Clare Difazio , the head of marketing at E3D, about the 3D printing industry and the leading extrusion system company E3D. She told us how 3D printers and extrusion systems would be the best. She also introduced their new RapidChange Revo. We thank her for the valuable information she shared with us. 

Don't forget to check out the 3D Dialog playlist to watch our other interviews with leading companies from different industries about 3D printers, subscribe to the Zaxe YouTube channel and turn on notifications for all that and more.

Zaxe is not just a 3D printer manufacturer. At the same time, with the ecosystem it provides, it offers solutions to meet the needs of individuals and institutions in education, industry and many fields.
